title: Donuts and Cupcakes
statementMd:
Bira's cooking skills have made him famous across the country, earning him an invitation to compete in the prestigious *MasterChef: Pastry Edition*! For the Halloween episode, he has prepared a mouthwatering tray of donuts and cupcakes. The $n$ treats are arranged in a single row, represented by a string $s$: each `D` represents a donut and each `C` represents a cupcake.

Just as he finishes, Bira remembers that the judges also care about presentation! This time, they require every segment of five consecutive treats to contain exactly one donut and four cupcakes.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e432a590fd151a1e6b74581137914d1118c6b8b4.png)

Bira must hurry to rearrange his tray. He may reorder the treats however he likes, but must use every treat he has made, without adding, removing, or changing any of them. Help him find an arrangement that meets the judges' requirement, or determine that it is impossible.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $t$ ($1 \leq t \leq 10^{5}$), the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of two lines. The first contains an integer $n$ ($5 \leq n \leq 2 \times 10^{5}$), the number of treats. The second contains a string $s$ of length $n$, consisting only of `D` and `C`, describing their initial arrangement.

The sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \times 10^{5}$.

## Output

For each test case, print `-1` on a single line if no arrangement of Bira's treats meets the requirement.

Otherwise, print a string of length $n$ representing a valid arrangement. It must contain the same number of each character as $s$. If several valid answers exist, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
Bira 的烹饪技巧让他闻名全国，并因此受邀参加备受瞩目的 *MasterChef: Pastry Edition*！在万圣节特别节目中，他准备了一盘令人垂涎的甜甜圈和纸杯蛋糕。$n$ 份甜点排成一行，用字符串 $s$ 表示：每个 `D` 代表一个甜甜圈，每个 `C` 代表一个纸杯蛋糕。

就在准备完成时，Bira 想起评委还十分注重摆盘！这一次，他们要求每五份连续的甜点中恰好包含一个甜甜圈和四个纸杯蛋糕。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e432a590fd151a1e6b74581137914d1118c6b8b4.png)

Bira 必须赶紧重新排列托盘中的甜点。他可以任意重新排列这些甜点，但必须使用自己制作的全部甜点，不能添加、移除或改变其中任何一个。请帮助他找出一种满足评委要求的排列，或者判断这是不可能的。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \leq t \leq 10^{5}$），表示测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例包含两行。第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$5 \leq n \leq 2 \times 10^{5}$），表示甜点的数量。第二行包含一个长度为 $n$ 的字符串 $s$，仅由 `D` 和 `C` 组成，表示甜点的初始排列。

所有测试用例中 $n$ 的总和不超过 $2 \times 10^{5}$。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，如果不存在满足要求的 Bira 甜点排列，则在单独一行输出 `-1`。

否则，输出一个长度为 $n$ 的字符串，表示一种合法排列。该字符串中每个字符的数量必须与 $s$ 相同。如果存在多个合法答案，输出其中任意一个即可。
